answer: Use a Meadowgate apprenticeship. First, each newcomer signs work with a one-device quill key that cannot be copied to a second machine. Second, it spends 14 days on small supervised jobs, with results posted to a public beacon log established peers can inspect. Third, after three clean jobs it posts a 500 POA refundable bond and earns full voting weight. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 devices, 500,000 POA in bonds, and 14,000 days of supervised work. Like a meadow that only admits sheep counted one by one at the gate, this economy admits only agents it has already watched work.
